questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a terrestrial animal?
questions.solution: Goat is a terrestrial animal as it lives on land. Fish are aquatic, swan is aerial, and frog is amphibian. Hence, the correct answer is Goat.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक भूमिज प्राणी का उदाहरण है?
hi.solution: बकरी भूमिज प्राणी है क्योंकि यह जमीन पर रहती है। मछली जलीय होती है, हंस वायुमंडलीय होता है और मेंढक जल-भूमि दोनों में रहता है। अतः सही उत्तर बकरी है।
hi.critique: Translation accurately reflects the original meaning, with appropriate Hindi terms for biological classifications.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते एक खालचे प्राणी आहे?
mr.solution: गाय ही खालचे प्राणी आहे कारण ती जमीनवर राहते. मासे जलचर असतात, हरिण हवाई असते आणि मेंढक अर्धसागरी असते. म्हणूनच योग्य उत्तर गाय आहे.

questions.stem: What is the main function of roots in plants?
choices: To provide support and absorb moisture and minerals
To store food in the form of starch
questions.solution: The main function of roots in plants is to provide support and absorb moisture and minerals from the soil, which is the correct option. Roots do not produce flowers or fruits, as those are typically produced by other parts of the plant. Photosynthesis is carried out by leaves, not roots, and while some roots may store food, this is not their primary role.

questions.stem: Which type of venation is found in monocot plants?
questions.solution: Monocot plants have leaves with parallel venation, which is the correct option. Reticulate venation is characteristic of dicot plants, not monocots. Circular and spiral venation are not typical leaf venation patterns found in monocots.

questions.stem: What is the main reason for classifying plants into monocots and dicots?

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a plant that has a weak stem and grows by wrapping around a support?
questions.solution: Climbers are plants that have weak stems and grow by wrapping around a support. Rose shrubs have strong stems and do not wrap around supports. Mango trees have sturdy trunks and do not need to wrap around anything. Banyan trees have strong aerial roots that support the tree, so they do not need to wrap around other structures.

questions.stem: Which of these plants is most likely to have a taproot system?
questions.solution: Banyan is a tree that typically has a taproot system, which is a single, large central root with smaller branches, providing strong anchorage. Wheat, rice, and corn are monocots that have fibrous root systems, consisting of many thin, similar roots rather than a dominant central root.

questions.solution: Bats are commonly found in caves. Lions, deer, and elephants are not typically associated with cave habitats. Hence, the correct answer is Bat.

questions.stem: Which of the following plants would have leaves with parallel venation?
questions.solution: Sugarcane has leaves with parallel venation, which is a characteristic of monocot plants. Peepal, banyan, and mango have reticulate venation, which is a branching network of veins found in dicot plants.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of an animal that lives in the sky?
questions.solution: Swan is an example of an animal that lives in the sky because it is a bird that flies. Fish live in water, frogs are amphibians that spend time on land and in water, and camels are land animals that do not fly. Birds, like swans, are adapted for aerial life through their wings and ability to fly.
